answer: I would anchor trust in Franchised cabin safety trainer certification with cabin crew attestation. With a certification crew officers renew after assessed drills, a single plume check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the ember compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the forge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
